description: This file defines the LoggingReceiver class which extends MidiReceiver. It processes incoming MIDI messages by converting them into a formatted string and logs the output, including timestamp information relative to when the receiver was instantiated.

classes.name: LoggingReceiver
classes.description: A MIDI receiver that logs incoming MIDI messages with timestamps to a ScopeLogger and Android log.

methods.name: LoggingReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with a ScopeLogger and recording the start time.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data, formats it with a timestamp, and logs the message.
